title: Odd cycle forces an odd directed cycle in a diconnected digraph
statement: Let $D$ be a diconnected digraph on a finite vertex set, so that every vertex is reachable from every other along directed paths. Suppose the underlying simple graph of $D$, obtained by forgetting the orientation of each arc, contains a cycle of odd length. Then $D$ contains a directed cycle of odd length.
hypotheses_covered: the underlying simple graph of D contains a cycle
replaced:
\emph{.  }A diconnected digraph which contains an odd cycle also
contains a directed odd cycle.*
